text:
maya patel: Hey folks, opened a small PR to fix an auth/retry edge in the Ruby SDK — streaming reconnects could hit a 401 and not trigger token refresh. Looking for quick :eyes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rb-sdk/pull/482
jon lee: Thanks, will take a look later today. Is it user-facing break or just parity with other SDKs?
maya patel: Parity + correctness. We were skipping refresh when a `Retry-After` header was present, but for streams that header can be missing. Added a guard and unit test.
riya shah: Can you paste the change here so I can eyeball it?
maya patel: Sure, snippet below:
```
# lib/redwood/client.rb
def handle_unauthenticated(response)
  # avoid duplicate refreshes from concurrent threads
  return if @refresh_in_flight
  if response.status == 401 && !retry_after_header?(response)
    refresh_token!
  elsif response.status == 401 && retry_after_header?(response)
    schedule_retry(response.headers['Retry-After'])
  end
end
```
jon lee: Looks reasonable. We should add a minimal integration test that simulates stream reconnect + 401 so we don't regress. There's been flakiness with the streaming matrix, so mark it stable-only.
maya patel: Added `spec/integration/streams/reconnect_spec.rb` and a tiny fixture. Triggered CI. ci-bot: build queued for PR #482
riya shah: Also add a one-line changelog under `CHANGELOG.md` -> Unreleased so customers know it's fixed in the next patch.
maya patel: Good call, done. Question: should we backport to 0.9-stable? A couple customers hit this in prod.
jon lee: If the fix is low-risk and covered by tests, backport. Open a cherry-pick PR and request a backport review.
maya patel: Will prepare cherry-pick PR after this merges. Thanks y'all! :raised_hands:
ci-bot: build passed for PR #482 :white_check_mark:
jon lee: Nice — merging after changelog and backport PR link.
maya patel: Merged and opened backport PR #483. Thanks for the fast reviews!
